1519.reportZh: 本基金於9月份錄得-1.02%回報。主要拖累來自全球債券策略。受債券收益率飆升和油價高企影響，富時強積金全球股票指數在9月下跌了1%。由於中東地區持續緊張的軍事局勢，導致石油供應存在不確定性，油價整個月都維持在每桶100美元以上。在科技板塊方面，與人工智能相關的股票熱潮持續，支撐了美國的大型藍籌股以及亞洲科技相關產業的股價。由於油價上漲、再加上持續的通脹憂慮以及主要中央銀行進一步加息，推高了債券收益率，導致全球債券市場持續承壓。富時強積金世界政府債券指數 （100%港元對沖） 在9月份下跌了1.6%。高能源價格、不斷增加的財政赤字、強於預期的經濟數據以及與人工智能相關的債務發行量增加，促使美國、歐元區和日本的央行均上調了政策利率。
1519.reportEn: The fund recorded -1.02% return in September. The main detractors were global bonds. The FTSE MPF All World Index lost 1% in September as surging bond yields and elevated oil prices weighed on market sentiments. Oil prices traded above USD 100 per barrel during the month as Middle East military tensions continued with uncertainty surrounding oil supply. On technology sector, excitement in artificial intelligence-related stocks continued to support large-cap stocks in the United States and tech-related industries in Asia. Global bond markets remained under pressure as rising oil prices, persistent inflation concerns and further rate hikes pushed yields higher. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index (100% Hedged to Hong Kong Dollar) was down by 1.6% in September. The combination of high energy prices, mounting fiscal deficits, stronger-than-expected economic data and rising Artificial Intelligence-related debt issuance prompted the central banks in the United States, the Eurozone and Japan to raise policy rates.

878.reportEn: The fund recorded -0.47 % return in September. The main contributors were the Information Technology and Communication Services sectors. The Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 4.3% whereas the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index gained 1.9%. Artificial Intelligence-related stocks and mega cap technology companies stood out as market breadth narrowed. Several top technology companies’ leaders had highlighted growing safety concerns around the pace of Artificial Intelligence development and had suggested to slowdown the frontier-model developments.

876.reportZh: 本基金於9月份錄得-2.04%回報。主要拖累來自歐洲股票策略。9 月份歐洲斯托克斯指數下跌了2.2%。歐洲央行將政策利率上調25個基點至2.50%，並指出能源價格上漲帶來的通脹上行風險。8 月份歐元區消費物價指數按年上漲了3.2% 。在切斷來自俄羅斯的能源供應後，中東地緣政治緊張局勢升溫削弱了歐元區經濟的韌性。富時MPF亞太（除日本外）指數9月以港幣計價下跌1.5%。韓國綜合股價指數在9月只輕微上升了0.3%。科技和能源板塊的升幅被消費相關股票的疲弱表現所抵銷。在人工智能相關科技股強勁反彈的推動下，台灣證券交易所加權指數在9 月飆升了3.9%。該島的工業生產和出口在8月錄得連續19個月的雙位數年度增長。
876.reportEn: The fund recorded -2.04% return in September. The main detractors were European equities. The Euro Stoxx Index was down by 2.2% in September. The European Central Bank raised its key policy rate by 25 basis points to 2.50%, highlighting upside risk to inflation from higher energy prices. The headline Eurozone Consumer Price Index rose 3.2% year-over-year in August. After cutting off energy supply from Russia, Eurozone economy is vulnerable to rising geopolitical tension in the Middle East. The FTSE MPF Asia Pacific ex Japan Index was down by 1.5% in September in HKD term. The Korea Composite Stock Price Index was mildly up 0.3% in September. The gains from technology and energy sectors were offset by the underperformance of consumption-related stocks. Strong interests in artificial intelligence-related technology stocks caused the Taiwan Stock Exchange Weighted Index to jump by 3.9% in September. The island’s industrial production and export sector registered double-digit yearly growth for nineteen consecutive months in August.

875.reportZh: 本基金於9月份錄得-2.16%回報。基金表現主要由於美國債券息率抽升所致。本月，由於聯儲局加息，加上經濟數據表現強勁，美國國債收益率曲線往上移。在亞洲美元信貸方面，信用利差有所收窄。進入 10月，由於地緣政治局勢維持緊張，當前宏觀經濟狀況和美國政策的不確定性，可能會改變市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期，美國國債收益率因此會持續波動。因此，中期優質亞洲美元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
875.reportEn: The fund recorded -2.16% return in September. Performance was driven mainly by the rise of the United States (U.S.) rates. The US Treasury yield curve shifted upward amid the interest rate hike by the Fed, and strong economic data over the month. Meanwhile, Asian Dollar credits spreads tightened during the month. Going into October, US Treasury bond yields may continue to stay volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, current macroeconomic conditions and uncertainties around US policies, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. As such, medium term high- quality USD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

657.reportZh: 本基金於9月份錄得-2.71%回報。富時強積金世界政府債券指數（35%港元對沖）9月份錄得下跌。基金表現主要由於環球債券息率抽升所致。9月份環球債券市場遭遇拋售。在經濟增長保持韌性、通脹持續以及政府債券發行量增加的背景下，政府債券和公司債券的息率紛紛升至多年高點。受中東能源基礎設施受損以及霍爾木茲海峽通行受阻的影響，油價攀升至每桶100美元以上，進一步加劇了市場對通脹的擔憂。聯儲局、歐洲央行和日本央行均在當月上調了政策利率，推動全球利率普遍走高。財政的擔憂在法國表現特別明顯，其10年期國債與德國國債的利差擴大至127基點，創下2012年以來的最高水平。10年期美國國債利率從9月的4.75%上升至5.28%。10年期德國國債利率上升26個基點至3.59%。10年期英國國債利率也上升36個基點至5.42%。
657.reportEn: The fund recorded -2.71% return in September. The FTSE MPF World Government Bond Index (35% Hong Kong Dollar hedged) posted a negative return in September. Performance was driven mainly by the rise of global rates. Global bond markets experienced a sell-off in September, with sovereign and corporate yields rising to multi-year highs amid resilient economic growth, persistent inflation and increased government issuance. Oil prices climbed above US$100 per barrel following disruptions to Middle East energy infrastructure and constrained traffic through the Strait of Hormuz, reinforcing inflation concerns. The Federal Reserve, European Central Bank and Bank of Japan raised policy rates during the month, contributing to broad-based increases in global interest rates. Fiscal concerns were particularly evident in France, where the 10-year spread over Germany widened to 127 basis points, its highest level since 2012. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield ended September at 5.28%, up from 4.75% a month earlier. The 10-year Bund yields up 26bps to 3.59%. The UK gilt yields also rose 36bps to 5.42%.

134.reportZh: 本基金於9月份錄得0.17%回報。本月，港元短期利率整體上升，而長端升幅較大，走勢跟隨美國國債收益率。進入10月，除了基於本地的資金情況外，地緣政治局勢持續緊張，當前宏觀經濟狀況變化和美國政策的不確定性可能會繼續改變市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期，亦會影響香港短期利率的走勢。
134.reportEn: The fund recorded 0.17% return in September. HKD short term rates moved upward broadly, with longer end rising higher, tracking the US Treasury yields. Going into October, in addition to the domestic funding condition, the elevated rate fluctuations driven by ongoing geopolitical tensions, evolving global macroeconomic conditions and uncertainties surrounding US policies may continue to shape market expectations on the US monetary decisions and impact HKD short term rates.

1579.reportZh: 本基金於9月份錄得-2.51%回報。主要拖累來自於香港股票策略。恒生指數表現落後於其他主要股票市場，9月份下跌了3.7%。聯邦儲備局收緊貨幣政策、美國中期選舉的不確定性、中東軍事衝突升級以及中美科技競爭局勢都打擊了投資者信心。恒生科技指數9月份下跌了7.9%。在8月，滬深300指數小幅上升0.8%。全球對人工智能相關硬體的強勁需求，推動資訊受到發達國家加息和國內需求疲軟的拖累，中國滬深300指數9月份下跌了5.8%。然而醫療保健板塊表現較佳，投資者對與人工智能驅動的藥物研發相關股票的興趣增加。9 月份，滬深300醫療保健分類指數上漲了2.8%。中國經濟仍呈現不均衡的增長。國內需求依然疲弱，零售銷售年增率從上個月的0.6%放緩到8月份的0.4%。但在海外對高端科技製造產品的強勁需求帶動下，8月份出口按年增長25%。本月，由於美國聯儲局在當月加息，香港政府港元債券收益率曲線跟隨美國國債收益率曲線走勢而上移。就港元信貸而言，信用利差維持穩定。踏入10月，在地緣政治局勢維持緊張、全球宏觀經濟發展以及美國政策不確定性的影響下，市場對美國貨幣政策決策的預期不斷改變，港元債券收益率料將持續波動。同時，本港經濟情況及投資於股票或避險資產的港元資金流向亦會影響港元債券收益率。因此，中期優質港元債券仍然是投資重點，以獲得具吸引力的回報，同時亦能減少利率波動對價格的負面影響。
1579.reportEn: The fund recorded -2.51% return in September. The main detractors were the Hong Kong equities. The Hang Seng Index underperformed and went down by 3.7% in September. The Federal Reserve rate hike, United States mid- terms elections uncertainty, escalation of Middle East military confrontations and intensifying China-United States technology tensions weighed on investor sentiment. The Hang Seng Tech Index lost 7.9% in September. Dragging down by interest rate tightening in the developed countries and soft domestic demand, the CSI 300 Index went down by 5.8% in September. Nonetheless, healthcare sector did well as there was a strong interest in stocks related to Artificial Intelligence-driven Drug Discovery. In September, CSI 300 Healthcare sub-index went up by 2.8%. Chinese economy is still on an uneven growth trajectory. Domestic demand remained weak with the yearly growth of retail sales decelerated to 0.4% in August from 0.6% a month ago. However, export expanded by 25% year-on-year in August thanks to robust overseas demand for sophisticated high-tech manufacturing products. Hong Kong government HKD bond yield curve shifted upward in September, tracking the US Treasury yield curve as the Fed hiked interest rate during the month. In terms of HKD credits, spreads remained largely stable during the month. Going into October, HKD bond yields are expected to remain volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, global macroeconomic development and uncertainties around US policies, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. Meanwhile, Hong Kong domestic economic conditions and HKD fund flow for equity investments or pursuit of safe-haven assets also influence HKD bond yields. As such, medium term high-quality HKD bonds continue to be the investment focus for attractive return while minimising the negative price impact from interest rates fluctuations.

142.reportZh: 本基金於9月份錄得0.03%回報。主要貢獻來自資訊科技產業。因為債券收益率持續上升，再加上有關人工智能治理的新聞成為頭條焦點，導致9 月份各類行業股份表現不一。道瓊工業平均指數下跌了4.3%，而以科技股為主的納斯達克綜合指數則上漲了1.9%。整體市場的參與度明顯收窄，上升動力主要來自與人工智能相關的股票和大型科技公司。幾家頂尖科技公司的高層領導都提及到對人工智能發展速度過急的安全顧慮，並且建議放慢前沿模型的開發速度。美國股票市場前景維持審慎樂觀，受到經濟增長具韌性及企業盈利穩健的支持，儘管宏觀不確定性仍然存在。2026年第二季的財報季表現格外強勁，標普500指數成分股的獲利超預期幅度接近29%，創下歷史新高。市場增長持續主要由大盤科技股及人工智能（AI） 相關的資本支出所驅動，同時能源和製造業也呈現強勁復甦態勢。
142.reportEn: The fund recorded 0.03% return in September. The main contributor was the Information Technology sector. Sector performance varied in September as bond yields continued to move higher and news related to the governance of Artificial Intelligence dominated headlines. The Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 4.3% whereas the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite Index gained 1.9%. Artificial Intelligence-related stocks and mega cap technology companies stood out as market breadth narrowed. Several top technology companies’ leaders had highlighted growing safety concerns around the pace of Artificial Intelligence development and had suggested to slowdown the frontier-model developments. The US equity market outlook remains cautiously constructive, supported by resilient economic growth and solid corporate earnings, despite lingering macro uncertainties. Q2 2026 earnings season has delivered exceptionally robust results, tracking record-high earnings surprises near 29% for the S&P 500. Growth continues to be heavily driven by large-cap technology and AI-related capital expenditures, alongside strong rebounds in energy and manufacturing sectors.

141.reportEn: The fund recorded -1.51% return in September.   At the country level, Netherlands was the key contributor, while Canada detracted. At the sector level, Information Technology added to the relative return, while Financials detracted.  Equity markets were resilient amid hawkish central bank actions, inflation fears and rising bond yields. Indeed, these factors were partly offset by renewed enthusiasm on AI. Looking ahead, as earnings remain strong, the key question is how far equity valuations could be compressed in a rising-yield environment. Hence, investment team’s focus is on resilient, non- disrupted business models with balance sheet strength.

146.reportEn: The fund recorded 0.14% return in September. Hong Kong government HKD bond yield curve shifted upward in September, tracking the US Treasury yield curve as the Fed hiked interest rate during the month. In terms of HKD credits, spreads remained largely stable during the month. Going into October, HKD bond yields are expected to remain volatile amid ongoing geopolitical tensions, global macroeconomic development and uncertainties around US policies, which influence market expectations on the US monetary decisions. Meanwhile, Hong Kong domestic economic conditions and HKD fund flow for equity investments or pursuit of safe-haven assets also influence HKD bond yields.
